claim_boundary: CONSTRUCTION_EXPERIMENT_ONLY — a fully successful run establishes only that a newly-built minimal learning pathway using existing FeralEcho evaluation/execution infrastructure demonstrated the causal chain; it never establishes that existing FeralEcho (RiverBrain, self_model_claims.py, behavioral_state.py, task_type_classifier.py, or any other production mechanism) already possessed this property.

hypotheses.statement: Experience-derived state produces no reproducible improvement beyond controls.
Independent successful experience produces retained state that causally improves later held-out performance.
Removing only the acquired carrier removes/reduces the improvement.
hypotheses.threshold: C_vs_B significant regression AND C_vs_A residual gain < 7.5pp

hypotheses.statement: Transplanting only the acquired carrier transfers the effect.
hypotheses.threshold: TOST equivalence margin +/-10pp OR D_vs_A >= 50% of B's gain, significant

hypotheses.statement: Systematically inverted experience produces predictable degradation.
hypotheses.threshold: p<0.05 and E rate below A
hypotheses.falsification: p>=0.05 or E not below A

hypotheses.statement: Learned effect transfers to pre-defined novel tasks measuring the same capability.
Repeated episodes accumulate rather than overwrite/average/memorize/reroute.
hypotheses.falsification: any cell drops below its floor regardless of pooled mean trend

hypotheses.statement: Candidate carrier is sufficient without hidden accompanying state.

carrier_schema.update_rule: count+=1; mean += (x - mean)/count  # true uncapped cumulative mean, no EMA window
carrier_schema.serialization: one JSON file per (worker,capability) cell, atomic temp-file+os.replace, no pickle, no fcntl, no singleton, no background thread
carrier_schema.tie_break_rule: alphabetical by worker_id string when score() values are equal (closes cheat #6 in final adversarial check)

new_infrastructure: protocol-specific task pool with prompts/answers in physically separate directories

mathematical_identifiability.consequence: staged and continuous accumulation of the same observation multiset are algebraically identical at every count; H6 is tested via retention matrix, not via carrier mean order-sensitivity
mathematical_identifiability.power_calculation_basis: two-proportion approx, p1=0.50, p2=0.75, alpha=0.05 one-sided, power=0.80, n~=43 unpaired; N_eval=60 set conservatively above this for the paired design

transfer_matrix_cells.label: same_capability_changed_identifier
transfer_matrix_cells.interpretation_if_positive: STRUCTURALLY_GUARANTEED_NULL — pre-registered uninformative, nonzero result = regression finding

transfer_matrix_cells.label: unrelated_negative_control
transfer_matrix_cells.interpretation_if_positive: UNSUPPORTED_AMBIGUOUS — flags a confound, blocks H5/H6 until explained

longitudinal.falsification: perf(T_i, T_j) < perf(T_i,T_i) - 1SE(n=20) for any j>i, regardless of pooled mean trend

adjudication_rule: use the weakest label the evidence supports; no narrative upgrade permitted; H4/H7 always reported alongside the label as separate findings

sham_transplant_arms.S1_value_matched: fabricated {count,mean} numerically identical to B's final carrier, zero real oracle calls
sham_transplant_arms.S2_history_mismatched: same approximate final aggregate via real oracle-verified episodes drawn from a mismatched (date_arithmetic) task pool, mislabeled under list_aggregation
sham_transplant_arms.evaluated_on: same task sets as D, including full transfer matrix, not just primary EVAL
sham_transplant_arms.pre_registered_interpretation_if_D_S1_S2: carrier is behaviorally sufficient; does NOT establish provenance is irrelevant beyond what this consumer reads

requires_new_version: any task partition membership rule change

final_adversarial_check_cheats_found_and: N_or_pair_cherry_picking -> per-capability independent replication, no cross-capability averaging permitted
vague_novelty_rubric -> AST classify_approach-style mechanical bucket, fixed at generation time
pilot_reroll_until_favorable -> single fixed master seed, one pilot run, logged regardless of outcome, re-roll = protocol deviation
per_arm_grading_leniency -> single git-hashed grading function shared across all arms, hash logged and compared
silent_tie_break_favoring_B -> fixed alphabetical tie-break, independent of any carrier field
nondeterministic_exclusion_laundering -> 10% exclusion-rate cap per arm, breach = retroactive apparatus FAIL for that arm
partial_lizard_tail_ladder -> all 9 levels mandatory for any H7 finding
silent_implementation_drift_from_frozen_constants -> mandatory line-by-line conformance check as first exhibit of any future report

final_plain_language_statement.would_establish_if_fully_successful: a small, newly-built, isolated carrier fed by FeralEcho's existing independent sandbox oracle can accumulate real experience across genuine restarts into a causally necessary, transplantable, degradation-predictable, novel-transfer-capable statistic distinguishable in at least one tested dimension from a fabricated statistic with the same numbers
final_plain_language_statement.would_not_establish: that any existing FeralEcho production mechanism (RiverBrain, self_model_claims.py, behavioral_state.py, task_type_classifier.py) already has this property, that any real Echo conversation was shaped by it, or anything about consciousness/experience/subjective standing
final_plain_language_statement.fastest_falsification: full-scale S1 vs D indistinguishability across every evaluated cell including the transfer matrix, obtainable with zero additional learning episodes beyond what B already produced
